channel.title: New South Technologies — Insights
channel.description: Federal legacy modernization, governed agility, FedRAMP, and responsible AI insights from New South Technologies.

item.title: Understanding OMB M-26-04: A Practical Guide for Federal AI Procurement
item.description: The new OMB M-26-04 'Unbiased AI Principles' changes how agencies buy AI systems. Here is what contractors need to demonstrate and what CIOs need to verify.

item.title: Explainable AI (XAI) in Government: Why Black-Box Models Won't Pass Audit
item.description: If your AI model can't explain its decisions, it can't survive an OIG review. Learn why Explainable AI (XAI) is a mandatory requirement for federal authorization, not a 'nice-to-have'.

item.title: CMMC 2.0 Readiness Checklist for DoD Contractors
item.description: Every system handling CUI needs a current CMMC status. Use this actionable checklist to assess your readiness before the next SPRS update deadline.

item.title: Why 'Governed Agility' Beats Pure Speed in Federal IT
item.description: Speed without auditability isn't progress—it's risk. Learn why federal IT needs Governed Agility: a framework that embeds compliance into every sprint, not an afterthought.

item.title: How to Achieve FedRAMP ATO Without Slowing Down Agile Delivery
item.description: FedRAMP and Agile are not enemies. Learn how to design DevSecOps pipelines that produce audit-ready artifacts as a byproduct of sprint delivery.

item.title: 5 Signs Your Agency's Legacy System Is a Compliance Risk
item.description: Manual compliance processes, siloed data, and undocumented interdependencies are red flags. Learn the 5 signs your legacy system is a ticking time bomb for your OIG audit.

item.title: The Strangler Fig Pattern: Modernizing Mainframes Without Mission Disruption
item.description: How the strangler fig pattern lets federal agencies incrementally replace legacy systems while cutting big-bang cutover risk and keeping systems operational.
